title: Config
intro: Where we're open, {market}'s fees, cancellation terms and timers, and the feature flags. Every change needs a reason and goes to the audit log.
introReadOnly: Where TasksNearMe is open, and who's waiting in the cities still to come. Admins change a market's status, with a reason that goes to the audit log.

outage.title: Outage switch
outage.intro: Pauses new bookings and payments in {market} during an incident (the payments incident runbook). Every signed-in page shows a notice while it's on.
outage.openBody: People can book, tip and pay for changes as usual.
outage.pausedBody: Nobody can book an offer, request a helper, accept a rebook or regular visits, tip or pay for a change. Bookings that exist go ahead: scheduled charges, Pay now, refunds and transfers carry on.
outage.pauseDescription: New bookings, tips and paid changes stop at once, and every signed-in page says so. Reopen as soon as the incident is over.
outage.resumeDescription: People can book, tip and pay for changes again, and the notice goes away.

search.title: Search engines
search.intro: What Google, Bing and other search engines may list from tasksnearme.com. Signed-in pages, staff pages and sample data never appear in search.
search.siteBody: Search engines list the site's own pages: home, cities, services, price guides, job boards, help and about. Task pages and helper profiles say noindex and stay out of the sitemap.
search.onBody: Search engines also list open task pages, and helper profiles with a completed task or a review, and the sitemap includes them. Closed tasks and empty profiles stay out.
search.default: No one has changed this yet: it's the site's default.
search.elsewhere: This copy of the app isn't tasksnearme.com, so it stays out of search whatever this says.
search.open: Open tasks and profiles to search
search.openTitle: Open task pages and helper profiles to search?
search.openDescription: Within a minute, robots.txt, the sitemap and those pages tell search engines they may list them. Only real open tasks, and profiles with a completed task or a review, qualify. Search engines pick it up on their next visit.
search.closeTitle: Keep task pages and helper profiles out of search?
search.closeDescription: Within a minute they say noindex again and leave the sitemap. Search engines drop the ones they listed as they visit them again.

markets.title: Markets
markets.intro: A market covers the ZIP codes that start with its prefixes. Outside every open market, people join the waitlist and helpers wait for their city.
markets.readOnly: Only admins can change a market's status.
markets.name: {name}, {state}
markets.helpersSettling: Helpers yet to choose a neighborhood

refused.time_zone_unsupported: {name} can't open yet: dates and times can't be shown in its time zone ({zone}) yet. Pausing works.

confirm.homePage: {name} is the home page's city: while it's paused, the home page shows no city's tasks or map, only the cities, the waitlist and how it works. To roll back a launch, move it to pre-launch instead: its pages stay up and nobody is emailed.
